Binds the config identity together with the release identities, the owner-approved switch posture, the PVC provenance and the must-be-unset override hooks. _held_candidates_doc: #251 part A, owner ruling 2026-07-29. A DECLARED held candidate is a field where the TREE deliberately runs ahead of what is RELEASED. Each entry pins BOTH sides, so only that exact pair is excused; move either side and the gate HALTs again. An UNDECLARED mismatch HALTs exactly as before. These declarations live inside the contract, so contract_sha256 covers them - one cannot be added without re-stamping. AT ADOPTION: re-stamp identities.<field> to the candidate value and DELETE that entry in the same commit. Removal is self-enforcing, not a convention: once the two sides agree, a surviving declaration excuses nothing and is itself a rejection naming the field.
